description: LMCs - Key Dimensions of Water Security (ADB - ADWO) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. Data on the LMCs on Key Dimensions of Water Security, developed by ADB. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Rural water supply, SDG6 Clean Water and Sanitation, Urban water supplies and distribution. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2018-05-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-IGO. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
